svg.title: Multi-agent chatbot: fully async LangGraph with six specialised agents
svg.desc: Architecture diagram. A user writes in Arabic or English. Requests pass through Nginx, a reverse proxy, to Dockerised FastAPI services; key internal APIs use gRPC. Inside a fully async LangGraph graph, routing through LangGraph Command instead of fixed edges hands control between six specialised agents, built as modular subgraphs. The graph calls four back ends: the Qwen LLM served with vLLM on A100 GPUs; hybrid retrieval that combines vector and BM25 search with LLM reranking; Brave Search through MCP; and a SQLite node-level cache.
